name: knitting-pattern-maker
description: Convert any image into deterministic pixel art and a complete, printable knitting pattern.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
